assertions.title: Newsletter body content with inline styles in email HTML

steps.observed: Profile stored successfully, app navigates to /promotion without redirect

steps.expected: Promotion page loads with card list
steps.observed: Promotion page loaded with all cards visible
Date range field populated, email HTML generation enabled

steps.expected: Newsletter card expands showing TipTap editor
steps.observed: Newsletter card expanded with heading field, toolbar, and editor

steps.action: Set rich text content via TipTap API with bold, italic, underline, highlight, h2, h3, ul/li, and link
steps.observed: All formatting applied correctly in editor
HTML Code tab shows generated email HTML with newsletter section

steps.action: Inspect newsletter section for inline styles
steps.expected: All CSS converted to inline style attributes, no class references or style blocks
steps.observed: All visual properties use inline styles. No <strong>, <em>, <u>, <mark> tags remain. No <style> blocks or class references found.

summary: VAL-EMAIL-004: PASS — All newsletter body formatting (bold, italic, underline, highlight, h2, h3, ul/li, links) is converted to inline styles in the email HTML. No <strong>, <em>, <u>, <mark> tags, <style> blocks, or class references found in the newsletter section.
